craft_notes: Sthāyin: middle-glide (the between as somewhere brahman MOVES: hatred-passion both refused). Rows: row 3 (free→middle). Close: middle (madhya — the word IS the landing). Rejected: 'middle path' — killed: middle kept bare (no path: glides forth middle, location not way); 'love' for passion — killed: passion kept (rāga as dveṣa's pair).

lines: No hatred contemplated anywhere, no passion:
free of both — brahman glides forth middle.
l4.sanskrit_cite: na dveṣam bhāvayet kvāpi na rāgam bhāvayet kvacit | rāgadveṣavinirmuktau madhye brahma prasarpati

reads_against.argmap: What glides in the middle? → Neither passion nor hatred — brahman glides forth in the middle between them.
c1_essence: Neither hatred nor passion contemplated: brahman glides middle.
